podcast.body: The only song on the *Brothers* album produced by Danger Mouse, it achieved major hit status. It was awarded the 2011 Grammy for Best Rock Song by Duo or Group with Vocal. "Tighten up from the black keys, the winner of the 2011 Grammy Award for Best Rock Song by Duo or Group with Vocal."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

"Tighten up for the Black Keys, the winner of the 2011 Grammy Award for Best Rock Song by Duo or Group with Vocal."

podcast.body: This song was recorded in the abandoned Muscle Shoals Sound Studio for their "Brothers" album, reflecting the band's determined effort to capture the studio's historical atmosphere despite its disused state. "The black keys and tightened up from the Brothers album recorded in what was at the time the abandoned Muscle Shoal Sound Studio in Northern Alabama."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
